svg.title: GainSec — a line of tricks, one per release or milestone
svg.desc: GainSec as a 3D skater (fixed low three-quarter camera, azimuth 30°, elevation 12°) rides a 4-trick line in a 16.2 s loop across an empty parking lot: asphalt with painted stall lines and a concrete wheel stop in every stall, a curb and sidewalk with a light pole, a city skyline behind. Tricks in order: 1. kickflip (RealHermes, an AR/VR Body, Voice, and Eyes for your Hermes Agent, Oct 19); 2. heelflip (TreeHouse Defense System – RF + Wireless SIGINT 3D/XR/VR Dashboard wi…, Oct 12); 3. pop shove-it (Verkracked Part 8 – VerkEye, Oct 4); 4. 360 flip (Bird Hunting Season: Molting, Sep 17). The list under the stage names each release or milestone in the same order and boxes the one being ridden. Folio No. 04 · OCT 2026.
